title: Training Notes on PAP Therapy Equipment Replacement
content:
# Training Notes: Replacement of PAP Therapy Equipment

These notes set out, question by question, when an owned PAP Therapy Equipment device is replaced.

**In what situations is an owned device replaced?**
In two situations. An age-based replacement is ordered no earlier than the class's reasonable useful lifetime in months after the device is set up, counting calendar months from the setup date with month-end fallback to the last day of a shorter month and the boundary day included; it needs a new practitioner visit where the class requires a new visit for replacement, but never a new sleep test. Before that point a device is replaced only when it is lost, stolen or irreparably damaged — with a police, fire or insurance report where the class requires one — or when the repair responsibility rules of PAP Therapy Equipment find repair costlier than replacement.

**What does a replacement open?**
The replacement opens a new device record with a new rental period and a new capped count; the old record moves to replaced.

**Are wear, a newer model or a preference reasons?**
No. Wear, a newer model or a patient preference is not a reason to replace.

**Where does the age count come from?**
From the setup date on the device record, as the system holds it.

## The age gate, element by element

| Element | Rule |
|---|---|
| Event the count starts from | the device being set up (setup date on the device record) |
| Unit | calendar months, month-end falling back to the last day of a shorter month |
| Comparison | the replacement is ordered no earlier than the end of the useful lifetime |
| Boundary | the day the useful lifetime is reached is itself allowed |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical dates, 60-month lifetime)

- Set up on 12 September of one year: the earliest age-based order date is 12 September five years later; an order on 11 September of that year is too early.
- Set up on 29 February of a leap year: five years later February has 28 days, so the earliest date falls back to 28 February.

## Before the useful lifetime

| Reason | Replaced before the useful lifetime |
|---|---|
| lost or stolen | yes, with a police, fire or insurance report where the class requires one |
| irreparably damaged | yes, with such a report where the class requires one |
| repair costlier than replacement | yes |
| wear, newer model, preference | no |
